Regenerate.Name: Regenerate Cache
Regenerate.Label: Regenerate Cache
Regenerate.Hint: Regenerate the token frame cache for all actors and tokens in the loaded world.

DefaultFrameImage.Name: Default Frame Image
DefaultFrameImage.Hint: The default frame image path to use when enabling frames for the first time.

DebugMode.Name: Debug Mode
DebugMode.Hint: Enable debug logging to the console for troubleshooting.

CacheFolder.Name: Cache Folder
CacheFolder.Hint: Folder path for cached frame images. Leave empty for default (worlds/[world-id]/token-framer-cache).

CacheResolution.Name: Cache Image Resolution
CacheResolution.Hint: Size of cached frame images in pixels. Value is used for both width and height (e.g., 1000 = 1000x1000).

CacheQuality.Name: Cache Image Quality
CacheQuality.Hint: WebP quality for cached images (0.5 = 50%, 1.0 = 100%). Higher quality means larger file sizes.

DefaultBaseScale.Name: Default Base Scale
DefaultBaseScale.Hint: Default scale for the base token image when a frame is applied (0.5 to 1.5).

DefaultFrameScale.Name: Default Frame Scale
DefaultFrameScale.Hint: Default scale for the frame overlay image (0.5 to 1.5).

DefaultMaskScale.Name: Default Mask Scale
DefaultMaskScale.Hint: Default scale for the mask shape (0.5 to 1.5).

DefaultOverlayScale.Name: Default Overlay Scale
DefaultOverlayScale.Hint: Default scale for the overlay/decoration image (0.5 to 1.5).

DefaultBgImageScale.Name: Default Background Image Scale
DefaultBgImageScale.Hint: Default scale for the background image (0.5 to 1.5).

Config.Title: Token Frame
Config.EnableHint: Apply a frame overlay to this token.
Config.ControlsHint: Enable to auto-apply frames to this token. Click Configure to customize frame settings.
Config.BackgroundHint: Use color picker on the preview to sample colors.
Config.OverlayHint: Image drawn on top of everything. Use for decorations, badges, or a second frame.
Config.BaseImageInputHint: The token image before framing. Use the button below the preview to sync from Image Path.
Config.FrameImageHint: Path to the frame overlay image (PNG, WEBP recommended).
Config.BaseScaleHint: Scale factor for the base token image (shrinks to fit inside frame).
Config.BaseOffsetHint: Pixel offset for the base image position (X and Y).
Config.MaskShapeHint: Shape of the mask. Overridden if a custom mask image is set.
Config.MaskImageHint: Custom mask image overrides the shape above. White = visible, black = hidden.
Config.MaskScaleHint: Scale of the mask shape or custom mask image.
Config.MaskOffsetHint: Pixel offset for the mask position (X and Y).
Config.FrameScaleHint: Scale factor for the frame overlay image.
Config.FrameOffsetHint: Pixel offset for the frame position (X and Y).
Config.BaseOverFrameHint: Draw the base image on top of the frame instead of behind it.
Config.RefreshHint: Sync base image from the token's Image Path field
Config.RefreshFromToken: Sync Base Image from Image Path
Config.SaveImageHint: Save the composited image to a file on the server
Config.PrototypeWarning: If editing a Prototype Token for the first time, click Apply Frame.
